instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Your assistance is required at the front desk.
atoms.b: Your ((assistance)) is required at the front desk.

atoms.a: The attendance at the workshop was surprisingly high.
atoms.b: The ((attendance)) at the workshop was surprisingly high.

atoms.a: It was fascinating to watch the aeroplane accelerate from 0 to 180 miles per hour.
atoms.b: It was fascinating to watch the aeroplane ((accelerate)) from 0 to 180 miles per hour.

atoms.a: The international mission to the moon was a huge success.
atoms.b: The international mission to the moon was a huge ((success)).

atoms.a: She based her decision on his detailed description of the situation.
atoms.b: She based her decision on his detailed ((description)) of the situation.

atoms.a: Making mistakes is a necessary part of growing up.
atoms.b: Making mistakes is a ((necessary)) part of growing up.
